title: Felix and the Machine
author: J. M. Almeida
blurb: Astrid Nystrom, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
